text.text_excerpt: We stayed here in June 2016 in a balcony room facing Ursulines Avenue which had a nice view of the area including the Ursuline convent grounds. Pros: The room was quiet at night, as far as street noise. The double bed was comfortable, there were two drawer units for storing clothes etc and the lights all worked. The air conditioning worked well and there is a ceiling fan above the bed. The TV worked well and had a wide variety of channels. As noted above this was one of the least expensive places in the French Quarter with a balcony access on the street side. They did have coffee in the mornings. This hotel was practically perfect!! It was close enough to the main part of the French Quarter without being too close to crazy parts haha! I also liked that it was close to the French Market. Sometimes the walk to the Bourbon Street area was a little rough but it's good for your right? The staff was very friendly and helped us with any questions we had. The room was absolutely beautiful! I had the best sleep ever in a hotel bed here. There were a few things like mini fridge/microwave in the rooms but I believe there were some available to use in the lobby. Two of the nicest things about the hotel other than the room was the courtyard and the lobby. We actually sat in the lobby on our fi...

Nice little hotel on the Esplanade side of French quarter. Room was clean and had a nice 2nd floor balcony over looking Ursiline. Quiet area with cute little French bakery across street. Room had queen soft top bed. I wish the sink was in bathroom and not next to bed, but it's doable. It's a old building but everything is clean and quaint. Cute little courtyard in middle but no pool. Elevator works but it is slow and old. Some rooms have stair access only. There is ceiling fan above bed and ac unit in wall. I recommend the balcony rooms.
